nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: Normative model is constructed by computing mean and standard deviation across the reference dataset (z-scoring); no specific normative modeling algorithm from the list is reported.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: To obtain normative models, the mean μ and standard deviation σ of the power spectra were calculated across the subjects from the normative dataset (Fig 1B).

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: Source-level power spectral densities (PSDs) were computed from resting-state MEG recordings at cortical locations. The PSDs were binned into six canonical frequency bands: delta (1-4 Hz), theta (4-8 Hz), alpha (8-13 Hz), low beta (13-17 Hz), high beta (17-30 Hz), and gamma (30-40 Hz). The spatial dimension was parcellated into 448 cortical regions.
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: An automated source-modeling pipeline was applied on the measurements to compute power spectral densities (PSDs) at each cortical location using the MNE-Python software.
